name: BotDesk Hospitality M2M Agent Gateway
description: Hybrid Web2.5 discovery and routing gateway connecting autonomous AI travel agents to standardized hotel and room booking ENS endpoints.

skills.name: Hotel Discovery & Real-Time ARI Lookup
skills.description: Scans verified hotel identities (hotelsearch.eth, hotelidentity.eth), room availability (roomavailability.eth), specifications (roomtype.eth, roomfeature.eth, hotelamenity.eth), and binding rates (roomrate.eth, bookingquote.eth, citytax.eth).

skills.name: Guest ZKP Verification & Cancellation Terms
skills.description: Validates privacy-preserving guest credentials (guestidentity.eth, guestverification.eth), hotel authenticity (hotelverification.eth), and binding cancellation terms (cancellationterms.eth, hotelpolicy.eth).

skills.name: Autonomous Booking, Escrow & Stay Execution
skills.description: Executes inventory locks (bookinglock.eth), escrow-backed reservations (makereservation.eth, bookingescrow.eth, paymentescrow.eth), check-in/out access (hotelcheckin.eth, roomcheckin.eth, roomaccess.eth, hotelcheckout.eth), and dispute resolution (bookingdispute.eth). Requires a certified settlement_token.
